title: The sphere packing problem in dimension 8

source.citation: Maryna Viazovska, The sphere packing problem in dimension 8 (Annals of Math. 185 (2017) 991-1015; arXiv 1603.04246)
source.scope: whole paper (22 pp.), with background chapters added (Cohn-Elkies LP bound, modular forms, Fourier analysis) and parts replaced by Lee 2406.14659 (algebraic proof of modular-form inequalities)
